title: Pure rapid-drainage compartment flux distribution

source.behavior: If total Kd > 1e-15, distribute total potential rapid drainage proportionally to compartment Kd in loop order; otherwise zero compartment potential and total potential flux.

scope: explicit interval and Kd-profile input arrays
strict total-Kd threshold, proportional distribution and zero fallback
100,000 deterministic bitwise comparisons at O0 and O2
non_goals: accepted macropore mass receipt or Richards state mutation
